summary: Well I coached two games and then got thrown into the third as an umpire. Long day but good to see kids working hard on their passion. Even if it is sportsball.

body_html:
Well I coached two games and then got thrown into the third as an umpire. Long day but good to see kids working hard on their passion.

Even if it is sportsball.
